That is the form downstream code writes, so it complements the `.inv`-form simp lemma `IsNilpotent.oneAddUnitOfPowEqZero_inv` without clashing with it. The clients apply the lemmas with `rw` followed by `toAdd_ofAdd`, which is already a simp lemma. This shows no failure of the simp set; it only shows the clients chose `rw`. I could not run Lean, so I cannot say whether `simp` would close those goals directly. I found no concrete missing, misoriented or looping rule.
